correctness.rationale: The support-function inclusion iP+a subseteq tP is equivalent to a in (t-i)P, giving exactly L_P(t-i) homothets at scale i, including distinct singleton copies for i=0. The Ehrhart positive binomial decomposition L_P(s)=sum_j h*_j C(s+d-j,d) gives mixture weight h*_j C(t+d+1-j,d+1); conditional scale probabilities equal BetaBinomial(t-j,1,d+1) by the beta integral. Each ratio C(s+d-j,d)/C(s+d,d) is nondecreasing in s, hence L_P(s)/C(s+d,d) is, so probability ratio to simplex is nonincreasing in i. Coupling through a shared Beta(1,d+1) variable and Bernoulli stream proves each strict tail when a positive j<=t occurs. When t>=d, equality forces h*=1 and normalized volume one, hence a unimodular simplex. Factorial moment identity follows from beta moments, and the finite-grid expansion follows from limiting mixture weights. Independently reconstructed 930 rational parameter cases (d<=5,t<=10), including all-tail inequalities, exact means, and the Pick-theorem unit-square example (9,4,1) vs (6,3,1). Finite checks are corroboration, not the theorem proof.
